To make things more dramatic, my sisters flights got booked immediately (after a short delay) and I put Trupti under quite a bit of time pressure. Yet she made it all happen in the nth hour, arranging materials, conducting the workshop on March 7–8, and even getting the clocks inserted professionally.

Yes, a few decor items were missing thanks to my design request, but Trupti is wonderfully jugaadu—resourceful, creative, and always focused on teaching the nuances while keeping the atmosphere light and fun.

If deep, beautiful resin creations are something you’re looking for, Trupti is definitely the artist and facilitator to go to.

Thank you, Trupti, for making this experience so memorable.
